ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Warscar
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SCARLANDS_STANDALONE_MOD_1 (Phase A row 20 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). A crater-scarred plateau of shattered megastructure floors and slag hills, still laid out like a defense nobody won -- bunkers, embankments, ruined turret rings and burnt shield emplacements all facing outward, poisoned ground that never clears, and machines still patrolling lines that lead nowhere. Fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign. A separate frozen campaign world's own Scarlands instance (RUT_Scarlands, src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches, labelled "Warscar" per the owner's naming ruling) is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the biome, reusing Odyssey's own first-party `RimWorld.BiomeWorker_Scarlands` worldgen worker (not a donor-mod type, so no extra hard dependency beyond Odyssey itself, which every RimMandrake biome mod may now assume per the owner's 2026-09-25 "always assume all the DLCs" ruling), plus two DUPLICATED flora defs -- `RM_Glower`/`RM_GlowerCrust` (this biome's only native flora; the black radiotrophic crust and its harvested product) and `RM_ScorchedStars` (a cactus shared with the frozen twin's own Wasteland sibling, duplicated rather than moved so neither twin gains a cross-mod dependency on the other). The frozen originals (`RUT_Glower`/`RUT_GlowerCrust`/`RUT_ScorchedStars`) are untouched and keep serving the campaign world exactly as before.
Three donor wildlife rows ship inline (`AA_SpinedGow`, `AA_Helixien` -- sarg.alphaanimals; `RG_Rimclaw` -- regrowth.botr.core), each individually MayRequire-gated. The remaining ten rows of the frozen twin's live roster -- eight genuine Star Wars/donor-tier fauna (`Mynock`, `RSW_CrystalFairyMole`, `RSW_MegaphoridLarva`, `SW_Electrictick`, `RSW_FoundryBeetle`, `RSW_Korrum`, `SW_Electricgryllotalpa`, `SW_Juggernautbeetles`) plus two RimUtinni-owned campaign creatures (`RUT_ScarRoach`, the Scarlands sibling of the Rust Cathedral's cleaner roaches; `RUT_MortuaryCrawler`) are wired onto this biome from `mandrake.rut.patches`' own `WildAnimals_Warscar.xml` (`PatchOperationAdd` onto this def's `wildAnimals`) rather than referenced directly here, because an RM-tier def may not name RimUtinni- or RimStarWars-tier content directly (Q11a) -- same shape as every other split biome's Star-Wars-fauna routing.
NOT absorbed here, on inspection: `mandrake.rut.scarlandsladder` (the reveal lore-stage table). Its own About.xml already states it correctly: "this mod is the RimUtinni half, per the engine/content rule in NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md Section 2" -- its `RM_LoreStageTableDef` hard-targets the frozen twin's own `RUT_Scarlands` defName by name, and even its placeholder stage-5 text already names an Ash'karr place (the Ashfall Road). Moving that content into a franchise/campaign-free RM mod would put campaign lore inside a mod whose whole contract is "nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it." This item's own analysis (SCARLANDS_STANDALONE_MOD_1 Section 10(1)) flagged this as a genuine open question rather than settled scope; on inspection the mod's own tier is correct as shipped, so it stays exactly where it is, fully untouched -- same disposition the Rust Cathedral build gave `RUT_ScarRoach`.
Also NOT absorbed: the frozen twin's own scaria-mark mechanic (`RUT_ScarlandsMark`/`RUT_ScarlandsMarkLock`/`RUT_ScariaOnsetArming`/ `RUT_ScarlandsMarkThoughts`) and its pre-sprung ruin dressing (`RUT_ScarlandsSprungDangers`). This item's own `## spec` section says outright that these satellite defs "do NOT need renaming for this item's criteria... don't invent extra scope" -- so this mod's own `biomeMapConditions` and `extraGenSteps` omit them; they remain exactly where they are, still serving the frozen twin.
Mod Settings: a worldgen-rarity master toggle (0 = never generates on a new planet) plus an honestly-disclosed reserved cross-biome section, matching every other split biome's shipped shape. Neither duplicated flora carries a bespoke mechanic yet (the frozen twin's own `RUT_Glower` harvest loop is still owed to `SCARLANDS_MECHANICS_2`), so there is no mechanic-specific toggle to add this pass.
Live-tile safety: the frozen `RUT_Scarlands` keeps its 90 live tiles on the canonical save untouched -- this build changes nothing about it, matching the compatibility-duplicate half of the item's own spec (it is frozen with a header notice, never deleted or repointed).
